title: Chapter 61 Bonfire Party
content:
Chapter 61 Bonfire Party

In the light of the calcium carbide fire, the Skeleton Knight and Ayub passed by each other.

The Skeleton Knight was knocked off his horse.

Generally speaking, skeleton knights and skeleton horses are inseparable.

When he was killed, it was also shattered into bones on the ground.

But at this time, they separated.

It can be seen that Ayub's blow was quite powerful.

Is the fallen Skeleton Knight still called the Skeleton Knight?

After a few breaths, he was killed.

Wang Shuo's experience value increased by a small amount visible to the naked eye.

Military merit points also exceeded 10,000 again.

Back at the Yellow Wind Valley camp, Wang Shuo directly used 1,500 military merit points to recruit three more brothers.

The three brothers Li Jianguo, Li Baoguo, and Li Weiguo have similar basic attributes to the three brothers Gong Zheng.

The main reason why Wang Shuo chose these three brothers was that their names were auspicious.

A cavalry transfer certificate cost 2,000 military merit points. Wang Shuo was not stingy this time and exchanged one for Baili Liang, using a total of 8,000 points.

Wang Shuo used the remaining military merit points to exchange for 4 horse cards, which was just used up.

Extra horse cards for emergencies.

When Wang Shuo handed Baili Liang the proof of cavalry transfer, he had a look of disbelief on his face.

He should now know the difference between himself and Gong Zheng and others.

That's why I'm so surprised!

As expected, his loyalty also increased to over 90, and he gained Wang Shuo's initial trust.

After using it, he was so excited that he danced on the Gobi, making Wang Shuo laugh.

At this point, Wang Shuo's swift scout cavalry squad was finally full.

Returning to Wana Village, Wang Shuo was filled with joy when he saw the prosperous scene of the village and the fully-organized cavalry unit.

It was decided immediately to hold a bonfire party.

Through such large-scale activities, it can greatly accelerate the mutual understanding among the residents, thereby enhancing cohesion and improving security.

At the bonfire party, Wang Shuo handed over to Duan Wenxi to take charge.

That's what he's good at.

Soon, people started lighting bonfires in a temporary square near the residence.

After a while, the huge burning fire was filled with people.

There were leaders who were good at singing and dancing, and they organized themselves spontaneously. They sang and danced, and it was very lively.

Wang Shuo specifically asked Xiaona to take out a lot of previously seized wine from the warehouse.

For a time, there was endless laughter and laughter.

In this chaotic world, it is rare to find a moment of peace.

Duan Wenxi wandered among the people in the various territories, complimented everyone he met, and quickly got along with everyone.

Wang Shuo was very happy for him to do this. He had to find an agent to carry out many of his orders.

At present, it seems that Duan Wenxi is a good candidate.

Wang Shuo focused on having a good chat with Ayub.

Ayub also knew nothing about his own life experience at this time.

However, he still retained his strategic vision and tactical skills in battle.

This made Wang Shuo feel that Ayub had become a killing machine that could only fight.

"Woof, woof..."

Just when everyone was wandering in the peaceful atmosphere, Dahuang's voice sounded at an inappropriate time.

Wang Shuo immediately got up and led his cavalry team to the door of the wall.

I saw a huge black bear on the grassland in the distance, preying on the antelope on the grassland.

After checking, Wang Shuo got the information about the black bear.

This was a level 10 black bear. When Wang Shuo saw it, the corners of his mouth turned up, showing interest.

At this time, Ayub said to Wang Shuo: "I am willing to be the lord and kill this bear to add excitement to our bonfire party."

Wang Shuo was surprised when he heard this, but he also wanted to test his fighting ability.

So he said: "Abu, I plan to take action personally, you come and hold me back."

Wang Shuo's move was intended to show his force and scare his subjects.

After that, he summoned a war horse and rushed over with Ayub and the golden-armored warrior.

With two expert guards, safety is guaranteed.

Even if you lose, it will be embarrassing, but you won't lose your life.

The bright moon hung high, the spear pierced the dark night, and the atmosphere suddenly became tense.

Seeing Wang Shuo rushing over, the black bear stopped eating and raised its two front feet high.

"roar……"

The black bear roared angrily, as if to warn Wang Shuo and others.

"Don't come over here!"

Under the moonlight, Wang Shuo saw the black bear's movements clearly.

After finding the angle of attack, in the blink of an eye, Wang Shuo's iron spear pierced the black bear's chest.

This blow only took away dozens of its health points, and it was completely like scratching an itch.

However, this move made the black bear extremely angry.

"roar."

It waved its front paw, trying to break the iron gun.

The black bear's strength is huge, but the hardness of the iron gun is also high and cannot be broken.

This time, all the power was transferred to Wang Shuo's hands.

Fortunately, he was riding on horseback and had a huge inertial impact, otherwise he would have fallen off the horse.

Feeling the power of the black bear, Wang Shuo easily drew back his spear as he passed by.

After turning the horse's head, charge again.

With the experience of the first strike, Wang Shuo was more prepared this time. The spear was not hit by the black bear, and smoothly left a wound on its body, with blood flowing freely.

Wang Shuo deliberately trained the skills of horse riding and fighting, and also used the dragon spear technique.

Galloping, circling and weaving, various skills gradually became familiar.

The huge black bear completely became a living target.

When the people in the territory saw Wang Shuo's fighting ability, they were so surprised that they couldn't speak for a while.

There was no contempt anymore.

Baili Liang's experience at this moment was the most profound.

He was only 3 levels behind Wang Shuo, but he had no strength to challenge the black bear, let alone the courage to challenge it.

He couldn't beat Ayub, he couldn't beat the Gong brothers, and even the three brothers of Li Jianguo, after checking their attributes, he didn't have the confidence to win.

He showed a bitter smile: "The gap between me and the lord is so big."

Wang Shuo originally wanted to shock the people, but at this time he was immersed in the battle and forgot about it.

He put his whole body and soul into the battle, and before he knew it, the black bear's health had reached the bottom.

[You killed the black bear and your level has been raised to level 10. ]

[Your "Dragon Spear Art" has been upgraded to level 2, and you have comprehended "Dragon Strike". You have gained all attributes +1, command value +1, and attack power +2. ]

After a hearty battle, Wang Shuo not only upgraded his level, but also upgraded his Dragon Spear Art to level 2.

[Dragon Strike: Consume 100 points of mental power, release a dragon-shaped spear force, causing huge damage to a single target, the damage value is all the player's basic attributes × 5, ignoring defense. Skill CD: 1 minute. ]

Seeing this skill, Wang Shuo smiled. This skill becomes stronger in the later stages.

However, he did not show it on the spot. This skill can be used as a trump card.

At critical moments, it will definitely have an unexpected effect.
